name: genesis-conductor-lid-lift-research
description: LID-LIFT Research: metacognitive dynamics, dissonance-weighted memory protocols, and physics-grounded energy frameworks for autonomous agents by Igor Holt (@invariantx), part of Genesis Conductor. Includes peer-grade papers: 'Beyond Retry: A Metacognitive Dynamics Framework for Autonomous Agent Failure Recovery', 'Dissonance-Weighted Eviction: A Hybrid LRU Protocol for Long-Horizon Agent Memory', and 'The Landauer Context: A Physics-Grounded Energy Basis for Large Language Model Orchestration'. Features mcp-tool-dissonance Podman artifacts, Zenodo publishing scripts. Directly feeds OpenClaw skill design, thermodynamic verification, persistent state, and MCP tool guardrails in production agent systems.
